text.tspan: Corrected three-tier architecture on EKS: each tier in its own subnets
nginx serving the built React files
ALB SG → app SG: only from the ALB's security group
app SG → DB SG: 5432 only from the backend
Inside the cluster, NetworkPolicy does the same between pods.
No NodePort: the Ingress sends ALB traffic straight to pod IPs (target-type ip).
The React code runs in the BROWSER, so the browser calls /api through the ALB.
DNS points TO the ALB (the arrow went the other way).
Database: managed RDS, not a StatefulSet you must back up yourself.
